# Android Flycast, source 7adbf3c

Four unmodified official Libretro archives report native version `7adbf3c`.
`provenance.json` retains source/archive/library checksums, ELF ABI identity and
Android-only libc/libm/libdl/libandroid dependencies. GPL-2.0-or-later and retained
component notices are under `notices/`; `recipes/` retains upstream CMake inputs
and submodule declarations. Exact gitlinks and conservative notices for eleven
potential components plus two nested sources are retained; optional linkage
is not asserted from source guards alone. Exact upstream Android NDK/build reproduction is not
claimed. Runtime downloads must pin the retained artifact commit. No retail
firmware/game is bundled. This artifact preparation enables no new route;
concrete VMU, mutable console flash, media, state and recovery checks remain
separate from packaged Thor acceptance.
